excerpt: Can we observe the oscillation of muon neutrinos to electron neutrinos? What is the ordering of the neutrino masses? ... The normal hierarchy, in which the third type of neutrino is heaviest, tends to favor oscillations of neutrinos over oscillations of antineutrinos. The inverted hierarchy tends to favor the opposite.
